{
  "candidate_rtl": "module comparator_16bit (
    input [15:0] A,
    input [15:0] B,
    output gt,
    output eq,
    output lt
);
    wire [7:0] e0, g0, l0;
    wire [3:0] e1, g1, l1;
    wire [1:0] e2, g2, l2;
    wire e3, g3, l3;
    genvar i;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin : bit_pairs
            assign e0[i] = (A[2*i+1] ~^ B[2*i+1]) & (A[2*i] ~^ B[2*i]);
            assign g0[i] = (A[2*i+1] & ~B[2*i+1]) |
                          ((A[2*i+1] ~^ B[2*i+1]) & A[2*i] & ~B[2*i]);
            assign l0[i] = (~A[2*i+1] & B[2*i+1]) |
                          ((A[2*i+1] ~^ B[2*i+1]) & ~A[2*i] & B[2*i]);
        end
        for (i = 0; i < 4; i = i + 1) begin : pair_groups
            assign e1[i] = e0[2*i+1] & e0[2*i];
            assign g1[i] = g0[2*i+1] | (e0[2*i+1] & g0[2*i]);
            assign l1[i] = l0[2*i+1] | (e0[2*i+1] & l0[2*i]);
        end
        for (i = 0; i < 2; i = i + 1) begin : group_pairs
            assign e2[i] = e1[2*i+1] & e1[2*i];
            assign g2[i] = g1[2*i+1] | (e1[2*i+1] & g1[2*i]);
            assign l2[i] = l1[2*i+1] | (e1[2*i+1] & l1[2*i]);
        end
    endgenerate
    assign e3 = e2[1] & e2[0];
    assign g3 = g2[1] | (e2[1] & g2[0]);
    assign l3 = l2[1] | (e2[1] & l2[0]);
    assign gt = g3;
    assign eq = e3;
    assign lt = l3;
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The original relational operators can synthesize into independently deep comparator cones. The rewrite uses a balanced lexicographic comparison tree, limiting comparison-combination depth to logarithmic levels while sharing equality-prefix signals.",
  "rewrite": "Partition the operands into 2-bit groups, compute equality, greater-than, and less-than for each group, then combine groups from most significant to least significant through balanced prefix nodes.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Reduced maximum data arrival is expected from the balanced comparison structure, especially for the greater-than and less-than outputs, with the exact improvement dependent on ABC cell mapping.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "The explicit shared three-state prefix logic may use somewhat more gates than the compact behavioral operators, but it remains within the stated area budget target and avoids duplicated equality-prefix logic.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For all 16-bit unsigned binary A and B values, gt, eq, and lt exactly implement A>B, A==B, and A<B respectively. The outputs are mutually exclusive and exhaustive, with no clocks, storage, truncation, signed arithmetic, or undefined behavior."
}
